gloss: to be reflected, to appear (on screen)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {映|うつ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be reflected, to be mirrored
definitions.explanation: For an image to appear on a reflective surface such as a mirror, water, or glass.

definitions.gloss: to appear (on screen/in photo), to come out
definitions.explanation: For an image to appear on a screen, in a photograph, or through a camera. Also used to describe how something looks or comes across visually.

examples.english: My face is reflected in the mirror.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{映|うつ}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The scenery of the town was reflected in the window glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}る⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms reflected on the water surface were very beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}った。
examples.english: It came out nicely in the photo.
Who is the person appearing on TV?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}ったようだ。
examples.english: His behavior apparently came across as selfish to those around him.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Transitive pair: ⟦{映|うつ}す→映す：12963_utsusu⟧.

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state — the image is currently visible/reflected. {映|うつ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is reflected / is showing.'

WRITING:
Distinguish from homophones:
- {映|うつ}る: to be reflected, to appear on screen — this entry
- ⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧: to be photographed, to appear in a photo
- ⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧: to move, to transfer

EXTENDED USAGE:
Can mean 'to come across as, to appear as' when describing impressions: …⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}る (to appear as … to someone). This is a figurative extension of the visual meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鏡|かがみ}→鏡：02190_kagami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}る: to be reflected in a mirror
- ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}る: to appear on TV
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{映|うつ}る: to catch one's eye, to appear to one
